The Challenge
Beyond the Red Pen
Traditional handwritten exam marking is a cornerstone of education, yet it's often a time-consuming, subjective process
that yields only a final score. What if every stroke of the pen, every equation, every diagram could offer a deeper story?
What if you could gain insights that truly inform learning, teaching, and strategic planning?
Our Solution
Gradie's Assessment Intelligence Platform
Gradie is an award-winning AI-powered platform that revolutionizes how handwritten exams are marked and
understood. Leveraging advanced Artificial Intelligence, including sophisticated handwriting recognition, natural
language processing, and deep learning to extracts comprehensive data from every student submission.
This data is then transformed into clear, actionable insights, empowering all stakeholders to make informed decisions
that drive academic growth and institutional excellence.
Gradie offers
Gradie offers tailored feedback and recommendations to the benefit of all stockholders
Making truly data-driven decisions isn't just an aspiration—it's the foundation for shaping brighter educational futures. By
leveraging comprehensive insights from student performance and learning trends

Administrators
Drive Institutional Excellence with Data
Leverage powerful analytics to optimize resources, refine curriculum, and ensure academic integrity across your
institution.
Scalable Assessment Solutions
Efficiently manage high volumes of assessments across departments and grade levels, ensuring consistent standards
and reducing operational costs.
Data-Driven Curriculum Refinement
Access aggregated performance data to identify curriculum strengths and weaknesses, informing strategic adjustments
and continuous improvement initiatives.
Proactive Student Support
Utilize predictive analytics to identify at-risk students early in their academic journey, allowing for targeted interventions
that improve retention and overall student success.
Enhanced Academic Integrity
While AI tools present new challenges, Gradie's robust system helps maintain assessment authenticity and provides
data to support fair evaluation practices.
Unwavering Security & Compliance
We prioritize the privacy and security of sensitive student data. Gradie is fully aligned with global education data
protection laws, including FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR, employing end-to-end encryption and anonymized data sharing.

The system analyzes student explanations to pinpoint specific misconceptions, offering educators valuable insights into

Feature Highlights
Teacher Control ('Human-in-the-Loop')
Each marked script includes automated, constructive feedback that aligns with national rubrics.
Empowers students and teachers to take ownership of improvement.
Secure & Transparent Records
All scripts, marks, and feedback are digitally stored.
Promotes accountability and can be used for audits or appeals.
Empowered Teachers
Teachers spend less time marking, more time teaching.
Boosts teacher morale, effectiveness, and support systems.
Real-Time Performance Monitoring
Dashboards show live updates on student outcomes.
Enables timely decisions around teacher support, curriculum adjustment, or student interventions.
Feedback-Driven Improvement
Each marked script includes constructive feedback that aligns with rubrics.
Empowers students and teachers to take ownership of improvement.
Early Identification of Struggling Students
Flags students who consistently perform below benchmarks.
Enables proactive remediation strategies before national exams.
In some case Identify children with Neurological challenge like dyslexia
Standardized Assessment at Scale
Ensures consistency in marking essay exams regardless of subject or location.
Reduces human bias and increases fairness in grading.
